snippet.title: Angry Birds Bounce Coming Soon!
snippet.description:
Hold onto your feathers! 🪶 We're thrilled to announce a brand new game on Apple Arcade: Angry Birds Bounce! 

Build your ultimate dream flock, master totally new ways to play, and outsmart those pesky piggies! An all-new experience packed with fun, strategy, and plenty of high-flying action will be hatching soon!
